title: Native compensation and physical current scaling research summary
evidence: Recorded local native public SKY130 ngspice47 simulations. No silicon measurement or PVT qualification.

families.scope: New native local ngspice47 public SKY130 TT 27 C fixed 50 mA AC screening. No pole or transient acceptance is implied.
Native nominal AC and closed pole screen. No load or transient acceptance is implied.
Native nominal TT 27 C screen with complete physical transistor current and charge scaling. No transient acceptance implied.
Native TT 27 C lead compensation screen at fixed balanced geometry. No transient acceptance implied.
Native nominal final resistor screen. No transient acceptance implied.
Native public SKY130 TT 27 C compensation screen for the supplied complementary driver. No transient acceptance implied.
Native nominal public SKY130 direct LVT driver compensation. No transient acceptance implied.
Native nominal local NFET feedback repair. No transient acceptance implied.
Native nominal test of the authorized finite adaptive damping device. No transient acceptance implied.
